title: Surreal Dream Weaver
description: A surreal fantasy scene shows a smiling crescent moon with a face watching over a wizard in blue robes casting lightning from a staff. Below, a woman in a pink top takes a selfie while chained to an ornate mirror, a person in orange overalls holds a 'Fragile Smile' box, and a soldier in green camouflage kneels in water holding a chain connected to a glowing green orb with red lava center. A small house sits on rocks in the foreground.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal fantasy painting featuring a smiling crescent moon with a face in a starry night sky. A wizard in flowing blue robes floats near the moon casting blue lightning from his staff. In the scene below, a woman in a pink top and cat ears takes a selfie on a floral bed while chained to a large ornate mirror. A person in orange overalls and cat ears stands in a wheat field holding a box labeled 'Fragile Smile'. A soldier in full green camouflage kneels in reflective water holding a chain that leads to a glowing green orb containing red lava. A small house sits on rocks. The background shows a waterfall landscape through a circular portal of leaves.
